entities.name: Implicit Maze
entities.description: A system of mana paths through Ravnica's guildgates and districts that manifested after the Guildpact was destroyed; whoever wins it gains great power for their guild.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: An Izzet planeswalker who discovered the Implicit Maze.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: The Izzet dragon who instructed Ral and announced the guild champions' race.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker whose notes were used to find the maze.

entities.name: Azor I
entities.description: Founder of the Azorius Senate who created the maze to be revealed if the Guildpact dissolved.

entities.name: Guildpact
entities.description: The contract binding the guilds, destroyed before the maze appeared.

entities.name: Forum of Azor
entities.description: The place at the end of the maze where great power lies.

entities.name: Transguild Promenade
entities.description: The meeting point where the guild champions begin the maze race.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The guild-ruled plane containing the maze.

events.summary: After the Guildpact is destroyed, the Implicit Maze manifests across Ravnica.
events.quote: manifested after the Guildpact was destroyed

events.summary: Ral Zarek discovers the maze on Niv-Mizzet's instruction using Jace's notes.
events.quote: it was discovered by Ral Zarek

events.summary: Niv-Mizzet announces that each guild will send one champion to run the maze.
events.quote: Niv-Mizzet has announced that each guild will send one champion as its delegate in the running of the maze

events.summary: At the appointed time the champions meet at the Transguild Promenade and race through the maze.
events.quote: At an appointed time, the champions meet at the Transguild Promenade and embark on a race through the twists and turns of the maze.

relations.note: Created to be revealed if the Guildpact dissolved.
relations.quote: The maze was created by Azor I to be revealed in case the Guildpact dissolved.

relations.note: Runs through Ravnica's guildgates and districts.
relations.quote: through the guildgates and districts of Ravnica
